channel.title: Nigeria - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Nigeria, every source cited.

item.title: Abuja hosts African prosperity conference
item.description: Leaders from government, business, and tech will meet on November 3 to discuss economic growth strategies.

item.title: MTN MoMo revenue jumps 102.2% in nine months
item.description: Customer wallet balances for MTN Nigeria's mobile money service more than quadrupled to N43.8 billion.

item.title: Osun building collapse kills three
item.description: Three people died and five were rescued after a two-storey building collapsed in Osun State.

item.title: Nigerian TVET programme makes UNESCO awards final
item.description: A Nigerian Technical and Vocational Education and Training programme has been selected as a finalist for the UNESCO global awards.

item.title: Nigeria cocoa exports to US jump 554%
item.description: Shipments reached $142 million in 2025, up from $21.7 million the previous year, according to the US Mission in Nigeria.
